trace_byte_provenance.authority: Current runs[].trace_path is the stable ZIP-member reference; runs[].trace_sha256 is the SHA256 of that actual portable member. Extraction path chosen by a reproducer is not its immutable identity.
trace_byte_provenance.not_modified: No inference, selector decisions, statistical computation, cases, observations, model/audio hashes, native timestamps, PNGs, ZIPs or original trace JSON headers were changed by this correction.
